item.title: Chamberlain stuns O'Leary with knockout win in Dublin
item.description: Briton Mark Chamberlain stuns Republic of Ireland's Pierce O'Leary as he dropped him twice on the way to securing a knockout win in the 10th round to claim the IBO light-welterweight belt.

item.title: Shittu 'robbed' - are AI boxing judges the answer?
item.description: After commentators claim England's Dimeji Shittu was "robbed" in the Commonwealth Games final, is judging helped by artificial intelligence the answer?

item.title: From Love Island to Commonwealth gold for McConnell
item.description: Team Northern Ireland boxer Jon McConnell tells BBC Sport NI of his decision to reject Love Island to pursue his childhood dream of winning Commonwealth gold, which he achieved with a split decision win over Wales' Orlando Holley-Sotomi.

item.title: England equal best boxing haul at Commonwealths
item.description: England equal their best ever boxing results at a Commonwealth Games, with seven reaching the finals and 10 claiming a medal.

item.title: 'Full heart, empty tank' - Eccles retires from boxing
item.description: The Welsh fighter confirmed she is hanging up her gloves before launching a verbal attack on "awful" people who tried to "end" her career.

item.title: Walsh through to gold medal match but Gallagher exits
item.description: Team Northern Ireland boxers Michaela Walsh, Kaci Rock and Jon McConnell win their respective semi-finals to move into Saturday's gold medal bouts, but reigning champion Jude Gallagher will leave Glasgow with just a bronze after losing.

item.title: Boxer's Commonwealth Games racism claim rejected
item.description: Claims made by boxer Aziz Abdul that racism was behind his disqualification at the Commonwealth Games are rejected.

item.title: Barney-Smith chasing 'statement' win over Bellotti
item.description: Royston Barney-Smith believes that a victory against Reece Bellotti on Saturday would send out a "massive statement" to the super-featherweight division.

item.title: World champion Dubois splits with trainer McGuigan
item.description: British world champion Caroline Dubois has split with trainer Shane McGuigan and will be relocating to America.

item.title: Fury v Joshua closer but hurdles still to clear
item.description: The long-awaited heavyweight fight between Britons Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua moves a step closer after they won their respective warm-up fights.

item.title: Watch every episode
item.description: Natasha Jonas and Chris Eubank Jr feature

item.title: Highlights - Joshua beats Prenga after early scare
item.description: In his comeback fight, Anthony Joshua suffered two early knockdowns but recovered to dramatically stop Kristian Prenga in the second round in Saudi Arabia.

item.title: 'I feel pain' - the British champion with no British passport
item.description: Bilal Fawaz has lived in the UK for more than 20 years, and is a Commonwealth and British champion. He tells BBC Sport about his fight to secure a British passport.

item.title: How lightbulb moment in Hazard's apartment helped Sheeraz
item.description: Former Chelsea winger Eden Hazard is a surprise inspiration for Britain's Hamzah Sheeraz on his path to world championship glory.

item.title: 'You can either go to the Olympics or have children' - how Reid recovered to fight again
item.description: Commonwealth Games-bound Derbyshire boxer Chantelle Reid reflects on how a degenerative back problem delayed her career and shaped her early life.

item.title: Rock on famous father's influence and emulating Taylor
item.description: Kaci Rock tells BBC Sport NI about growing up with a famous father, looking up to Katie Taylor and challenging stereotypes surrounding female boxers.

item.title: What is Zuffa Boxing and can it shake up the sport?
item.description: From promoter rivalries to the shock signing of some big names, Zuffa Boxing's start to life in the sport has been far from quiet.

item.title: 'Cousin Amir opened doors, now it's my time' - Abdul Khan
item.description: Abdul Khan tells BBC Sport about learning from his cousin Amir, a former world champion, and his ambitions to reach the pinnacle of the sport.

item.title: How a kickboxing legend & Statham's pal landed a shot at Usyk
item.description: Dutchman Rico Verhoeven discusses his kickboxing career, friendship with A-list celebrities and how he landed a shot at Oleksandr Usyk.

item.title: The decade-long struggle to get AJ & Fury together
item.description: Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua shared a moment on Saturday, but getting the British heavyweights together this year may not be as straightforward as many suspected.

item.title: 'You're under arrest' - how Ngamba made history against all odds
item.description: Cindy Ngamba shares her incredible story from refugee to Olympic medallist.

item.title: 'I wouldn't wish what I went through on my worst enemy'
item.description: Undisputed middleweight boxing world champion Claressa Shields opens up about her harrowing journey to the top of her sport.

item.title: From rock bottom to three world titles at 37
item.description: Natasha Jonas tells her story, including what it took to come back and win three world titles at 37.

item.title: Being a Eubank, living up to dad and dealing with grief
item.description: Born To Brawl: Chris Eubank Jr tells his story of grief and living up to his dad

item.title: Are Prince Naseem Hamed's sons coming for his throne?
item.description: Get to know the Hameds' journey ahead of Aadam Hamed's debut on the Oleksandr Usyk v Daniel Dubois undercard.

item.title: Tyson rates him: Is traveller Dennis McCann boxing's next superstar?
item.description: Tyson Fury tips traveller boxer Dennis ‘The Menace’ McCann as future world champion

item.title: Phantom v Price - can a Gladiator keep up with a world champion?
item.description: Lauren Price meet Gladiator Phantom for a training session in the boxing gym.

item.title: Church told me I was possessed by demons aged 12
item.description: Conor Benn tells BBC Sport about growing up in an "extreme" Christian school, being told he was "demon-possessed" and how he had to rebuild a relationship with his father Nigel.

item.title: 'I gave everything to boxing and still have nothing'
item.description: Heather Hardy tells BBC Sport how she is adapting to life outside of boxing after the former world champion was left with a life-threatening injury.
